topic: 伽马振荡与神经绑定问题

sources.title: Stimulus-specific neuronal oscillations in orientation columns of cat visual cortex
sources.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences USA
sources.usage: 伽马振荡的原始实验发现：猫 V1 约 40 Hz 振荡，皮层内生而非丘脑继承
sources.notes: 经典实验，已被大量后续研究重复

sources.title: Oscillatory responses in cat visual cortex exhibit inter-columnar synchronization which reflects global stimulus properties
sources.usage: 跨皮层柱的伽马同步随刺激全局属性变化；绑定假说的直接证据
sources.notes: 未读取全文（订阅墙）；摘要提供了核心发现

sources.title: Mechanisms of gamma oscillations
sources.usage: PING/ING 机制的权威综述；PV 中间神经元的关键作用；伽马子带的区分
sources.notes: 权威综述，整合了大量实验室数据

sources.title: Rhythms for Cognition: Communication through Coherence
sources.usage: CTC 框架；注意力调节伽马同步的实验证据（Bosman et al. 2012）；频段分工（γ前馈，α/β反馈）
sources.notes: 高影响力综述，CTC 假说的主要阐述者

sources.title: Binding of cortical functional modules by synchronous high-frequency oscillations
sources.usage: 颅内 EEG 发现语言认知绑定时 co-ripples（~90 Hz）增加；跨区域（>12 cm）高频同步
sources.notes: 未读取全文（订阅墙）；摘要提供了核心发现。颅内 EEG 样本来自癫痫患者

sources.title: Distinct oscillatory patterns differentiate between segregation and integration processes in perceptual grouping
sources.usage: 反直觉发现：γ 在分离（而非整合）感知时增加；α/β 在整合时增加
sources.notes: 与绑定假说预测相反；被动感知歧义刺激范式；需要独立复制

sources.title: Fast spiking interneurons autonomously generate fast gamma oscillations in the medial entorhinal cortex with excitation strength tuning ING-PING transitions
sources.usage: 内嗅皮层中 ING-PING 转换机制；兴奋强度决定振荡模式
sources.notes: 2026 年新发表；主要在内嗅皮层/网格细胞背景下研究，不直接针对视觉绑定

sources.title: Intensity-dependent modulation of the early auditory gamma-band response in first-episode schizophrenia and its association with disease symptoms
sources.usage: 精神分裂症患者早期听觉伽马振荡减弱；与阴性症状相关
sources.notes: 首发患者样本（n=35），MEG 研究；一个时间点，无纵向数据

sources.title: Synchrony unbound: a critical evaluation of the temporal binding hypothesis
sources.usage: 绑定假说的经典批评：同步不等于绑定；读码机制不明确
sources.notes: 未读取全文；摘要推断核心论点；该批评仍然有效
